body.message:
You may pass by Unit 407 for the viewing. The door will be open for your convenience.

Please note that the unit you will be viewing currently has in-house guests, so it will not be possible to view the occupied apartment itself. However, this will give you a good idea of the layout and overall look and feel of the unit.

We hope this works for you, and please feel free to let us know if you need any further assistance.
